name: Espresso
description: A single shot of our house blend. Dark chocolate, toasted hazelnut, a long sweet finish.

name: Doppio
description: Two shots of house espresso in a small cup. The one regulars order before they've said hello.

name: Cortado
description: Double espresso cut with an equal measure of warm milk. Small and strong.

name: Caramel cortado
description: Our cortado with a spoon of house-made salted caramel stirred through.

name: Flat white
description: Double ristretto under a thin layer of velvety milk. More coffee than milk.

name: Cappuccino
description: Double espresso, steamed milk and a deep cap of foam. Cocoa dusting if you ask.

name: Oat latte
description: Double espresso with steamed barista oat milk. No extra charge for the oat.

name: Americano
description: Double espresso topped with hot water. Ask for room if you take milk.

name: Mocha
description: Double espresso, 54% dark chocolate and steamed milk. Dessert in a mug.

name: Red eye
description: A mug of filter coffee with a shot of espresso dropped in. For the early shift.

name: Today's pour
description: Guatemalan filter, bright and a bit like red apple. Changes when the bag runs out.

name: Iced latte
description: Double espresso poured over ice and cold milk. Sweetened only if you ask.

name: Cold brew
description: Steeped for 18 hours and served over ice. Smooth and low in acidity.

name: English breakfast tea
description: Loose-leaf Assam blend brewed in a pot for one. Milk on the side.

name: Chai latte
description: Black tea simmered with cardamom, ginger and cinnamon, then steamed with milk.

name: Matcha latte
description: Ceremonial-grade matcha whisked by hand and topped with steamed oat milk.

name: Hot chocolate
description: 54% dark chocolate melted into steamed milk. Marshmallows on request.

name: Almond croissant
description: Twice-baked butter croissant filled with frangipane and topped with flaked almonds.

name: Cinnamon bun
description: Cardamom dough rolled with brown sugar and cinnamon, baked every morning at 6.

name: Banana bread
description: A thick slice of our walnut banana bread. Good toasted with butter.

name: Cheese and chive scone
description: Mature cheddar and chive scone served warm with salted butter.

name: Grilled cheese and tomato soup
description: Sharp cheddar and a little mustard on toasted sourdough, with a cup of roasted tomato soup for dunking.

name: Soup of the day
description: Whatever the kitchen made this morning, served with a thick slice of buttered sourdough. Ask at the counter.

name: Avocado toast
description: Smashed avocado on toasted sourdough with lemon, chilli flakes and a soft-boiled egg on the side.

name: Seasonal grain salad
description: Farro and quinoa with roasted squash, toasted cashews and a sharp lemon dressing. Changes with the market.

name: Turkey and Swiss on rye
description: Roast turkey, Swiss cheese, pickles and grainy mustard on seeded rye. Pressed if you like it warm.
